must_define: preconditions and hard gates per transition
must_not_do: allow services to invoke parent transitions directly
allow invalid transitions because a provider returned SUCCESS
manufacture author approval or human evidence
mutate canonical state partially after any failed precondition
silently discard stale evidence, disagreements, rejected proposals or rollback state
closure_criteria: legal project and unit transitions are executable
illegal or premature transitions fail closed
author-required transitions block without explicit recorded author decision
upstream changes deterministically invalidate dependent units/evidence/proposals
service responses cannot bypass parent integration/admission
replay is deterministic and cannot double-commit
every successful transition emits a receipt linking pre-state, operation set, post-state and rollback identity
adversarial qualification proves atomicity, invalidation, stale-response and authority boundaries
